[rollout] Set up GH-AW and install shared PR review workflows (#1144)

## Summary

This PR sets up GitHub Agentic Workflows (GH-AW) and installs shared PR
review workflows from `pulumi-labs/gh-aw-internal`.

## Commands Executed

````
gh-aw init
gh-aw add pulumi-labs/gh-aw-internal/.github/workflows/gh-aw-pr-review.md@main --name kubernetes-operator-pr-review --force
gh-aw add pulumi-labs/gh-aw-internal/.github/workflows/gh-aw-pr-rereview.md@main --name kubernetes-operator-pr-rereview --force
gh-aw compile
gh-aw validate
```

## Rollout Details

- **AW entrypoint used**: `gh-aw` (standalone, v0.56.2)
- **Target base branch**: `master`
- **Prefix stem**: `kubernetes-operator` (derived from
`pulumi-kubernetes-operator` by stripping `pulumi-` prefix)
- **gh aw init**: Ran (`.github/aw/actions-lock.json` was not present)

## Changed Files

- `.gitattributes` — added by init for merge strategy attributes
- `.github/agents/agentic-workflows.agent.md` — agent definition added
by init
- `.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml` — generated dependency
workflow
- `.github/workflows/kubernetes-operator-pr-review.md` — installed
shared PR review workflow
- `.github/workflows/kubernetes-operator-pr-review.lock.yml` — compiled
lock file for pr-review
- `.github/workflows/kubernetes-operator-pr-rereview.md` — installed
shared PR re-review workflow
- `.github/workflows/kubernetes-operator-pr-rereview.lock.yml` —
compiled lock file for pr-rereview
- `.github/workflows/shared/review.md` — shared review logic
- `.github/workflows/shared/plugins/code-review/code-review.md` — code
review plugin

## Validation Output

**gh aw compile:**
```
⚠ Compiled 2 workflow(s): 0 error(s), 2 warning(s)
```

**gh aw validate:**
```
⚠ Compiled 2 workflow(s): 0 error(s), 2 warning(s)
```

## Validation Warnings

Both workflows produced the same non-blocking warning:
```
warning: This workflow grants id-token: write permission
OIDC tokens can authenticate to cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Ensure proper audience validation and trust policies are configured.
````

This is expected for PR review workflows that authenticate with cloud
providers and is non-blocking.
